title: ‘Close to zero impact’: US study casts doubt on effect of phone ban in schools

paragraphs.english: This page is an independently written reading guide to a news report by Richard Adams in The Guardian, first published online on 5 May 2026. Follow the original-article link below for the publisher’s full text.
paragraphs.chinese: 本页是为《卫报》记者理查德·亚当斯（Richard Adams）的一篇新闻报道独立撰写的阅读导读。该报道于2026年5月5日首次在线发布。请通过下方原文链接阅读出版方提供的全文。

paragraphs.english: England is moving towards a legal requirement that state schools keep phones away from students during the school day, and the case for that step has rested largely on a simple hope: take the devices out of students’ hands and learning will improve. A large American study reported in May put that hope to the test, and its answer is uncomfortable for everyone in the argument.
paragraphs.chinese: 英格兰正着手立法，要求公立学校在上课日让学生远离手机；支持这一举措的理由，很大程度上建立在一个朴素的期待上：把手机从学生手里拿走，学习就会变好。今年5月报道的一项大规模美国研究检验了这个期待，而它给出的答案，让争论中的各方都不太舒服。

paragraphs.english: The study followed nearly 1,800 secondary schools in the United States that had adopted a strict version of the policy: students’ phones were sealed in magnetic locked pouches for the school day. The researchers compared these schools with similar ones that had no such rule, looking at standardised test scores and at non-academic measures such as attendance, attention in class and students’ own reports of online bullying. The findings were issued as a working paper by the National Bureau of Economic Research.
paragraphs.chinese: 这项研究追踪了美国近1800所中学，这些学校采用的是最严格的一类做法：上课日把学生的手机封进磁吸锁袋里。研究者把这些学校与没有此类规定的同类学校作比较，考察标准化考试成绩，也考察出勤、课堂注意力和学生自述的网络霸凌经历等非学业指标。研究结果以工作论文的形式由美国国家经济研究局（NBER）发布。

paragraphs.english: On the central question the results were flat. Average effects on test scores were close to zero, and the estimates were precise enough that the null result is hard to dismiss as statistical noise. Attendance, classroom attention and perceived online bullying showed effects that were similarly small. The averages did hide some variation — older students gained modestly in maths while younger pupils did slightly worse — but neither shift was large.
paragraphs.chinese: 在最核心的问题上，结果是平板一块。对考试成绩的平均影响接近于零，而且估计精度足够高，很难把这个“无效应”的结果当作统计噪声打发掉。出勤、课堂注意力和学生感知到的网络霸凌，效应同样很小。平均值确实掩盖了一些差异——高年级学生在数学上有小幅提升，低年级学生则略差一些——但两个方向的变动都不大。

paragraphs.english: The first year of a ban was harder than the years that followed. Suspensions rose and students’ sense of wellbeing dipped, apparently as schools worked out how to enforce the new rule. Those effects then faded, and wellbeing later rose above its level before the ban.
paragraphs.chinese: 禁令实施的第一年比之后几年更难。停学处分增加了，学生的幸福感有所下降，看起来是因为学校还在摸索如何执行新规定。这些效应随后逐渐消退，幸福感后来还回升到了禁令实施前的水平之上。

paragraphs.english: What the policy did change was behaviour. Using location data from the phones themselves, the researchers found a substantial fall in phone activity by the third year of a ban. Students really were using their phones far less; the improvement simply did not appear in the outcomes the study was able to measure.
paragraphs.chinese: 政策真正改变的是行为。研究者利用手机本身产生的位置数据发现，到禁令实施的第三年，手机活动量大幅下降。学生确实在少用手机，只是这种改善没有出现在这项研究能够测量的那些指标上。

paragraphs.english: Thomas Dee of Stanford University, one of the authors, argued that a mixed picture is not a reason to abandon the policy. He told NPR that reading the results as a case for walking away would be a serious mistake, pointing to the falling phone use and to signs that schools with longer experience of bans were beginning to record more positive results.
paragraphs.chinese: 作者之一、斯坦福大学的托马斯·迪（Thomas Dee）认为，结果有好有坏并不构成放弃该政策的理由。他对美国国家公共电台（NPR）表示，把这些结果解读成“应当退出”会是严重错误；他举出的依据是手机使用量的下降，以及一些迹象——禁令实施更久的学校开始出现更积极的结果。

paragraphs.english: In England the report has landed in the middle of a live argument. The children’s commissioner has found that more than nine in ten schools already restrict phones in some form, and the new statutory rules are expected to be stricter, requiring phones to be handed in or locked away. The Girls’ Day School Trust, which runs 25 schools, will bar phones for pupils up to year 11 from September, citing evidence about harm to girls in particular. Separately, the exam regulator has warned that more than 500 candidates were disqualified last year for taking phones or smart watches into exam halls.
paragraphs.chinese: 在英格兰，这份报告正好落进一场仍在进行的争论当中。儿童事务专员发现，十所学校里有九所多已经以某种形式限制手机，而新的法定规则预计会更严格，要求手机上交或锁存。运营25所学校的“女子走读学校信托”（Girls’ Day School Trust）将从9月起禁止11年级及以下学生带手机，理由是有关手机尤其对女生造成伤害的证据。另外，考试监管机构警告说，去年有500多名考生因把手机或智能手表带入考场而被取消成绩。

paragraphs.english: Read the piece with two distinctions in mind. The first is between no measurable average effect and no effect at all: a policy can change daily behaviour, as the location data show, without moving the particular numbers a study is able to collect. The second is between short-run disruption and long-run results, since the first year of any ban looks worse than the years that follow it.
paragraphs.chinese: 阅读时请留意两组区分。第一组是“测不出平均效应”与“根本没有效应”之间的区别：正如位置数据所示，一项政策可以改变日常行为，却不牵动研究恰好能够采集到的那几个数字。第二组是短期阵痛与长期结果之间的区别——任何禁令的第一年，看起来都比之后的几年更糟。

paragraphs.english: Here is an editor-written practice sentence, not a quotation from the original article: Even where a policy changes behaviour in the way its supporters hoped, the outcomes that matter most may take years to show up in the data — and they may never show up in the measures a study happens to choose.
paragraphs.chinese: 以下是编辑撰写的练习句，并非原文引句：即便一项政策如支持者所愿改变了行为，最重要的那些结果也可能要多年之后才在数据中显现——甚至可能永远不会出现在某项研究恰好选用的测量指标里。

paragraphs.english: As you read, notice how the report keeps three things separate: what the study measured, what the authors concluded, and what politicians and schools decided to do. Pay attention to the careful verbs — “casts doubt on”, “close to zero”, “modest” — which do far more work here than any single figure, and watch how the closing paragraphs move from evidence to policy without claiming that the evidence settles the argument.
paragraphs.chinese: 阅读时留意报道如何把三件事分开：研究测量了什么、作者得出了什么结论、政界和学校又决定怎么做。注意那些谨慎的动词——“使人生疑”“接近于零”“小幅”——它们在这里起的作用远超任何单个数字；同时观察结尾几段如何从证据过渡到政策，却没有声称证据已经了结了这场争论。

sentenceNotes.sentence: The researchers compared these schools with similar ones that had no such rule, looking at standardised test scores and at non-academic measures such as attendance, attention in class and students’ own reports of online bullying.
sentenceNotes.mainClause: 主句为 The researchers compared these schools with similar ones，主语 the researchers，谓语 compared，宾语 these schools，with similar ones 表示比较对象。
sentenceNotes.structure: that had no such rule 是修饰 ones 的定语从句；looking at... 是现在分词短语作伴随状语，说明比较时看的是哪些指标；such as 引出的三个并列名词短语（attendance、attention in class、students’ own reports of online bullying）是对 non-academic measures 的举例。
sentenceNotes.translation: 研究者把这些学校与没有此类规定的同类学校作比较，考察标准化考试成绩，也考察出勤、课堂注意力和学生自述的网络霸凌经历等非学业指标。
sentenceNotes.tip: ones 是代词，回指前面的 schools，不要把 similar ones 误读成“相似的某一样东西”。compare A with B 是“把A与B比较”；句末长长的 looking at 部分只是补充说明研究看了哪些指标，抓主干时可先跳过。

sentenceNotes.sentence: The first is between no measurable average effect and no effect at all: a policy can change daily behaviour, as the location data show, without moving the particular numbers a study is able to collect.
sentenceNotes.mainClause: 冒号前 The first is between no measurable average effect and no effect at all 是主句，主语 The first，系动词 is，表语是 between... 介词短语；冒号后是解释性分句，主干为 a policy can change daily behaviour。
sentenceNotes.structure: between A and B 中的 A 是 no measurable average effect，B 是 no effect at all，两者只差 measurable 一词，正是全句要辨析的地方；as the location data show 是插入的as 从句，意为“正如……所示”；without moving... 是介词短语作状语，表示“而没有改变……”；a study is able to collect 是省略关系词的定语从句，修饰 numbers。
sentenceNotes.translation: 第一组是“测不出平均效应”与“根本没有效应”之间的区别：正如位置数据所示，一项政策可以改变日常行为，却不牵动研究恰好能够采集到的那几个数字。
sentenceNotes.tip: 本句难点在抽象名词的对照：measurable（可测量的）只是方法论层面的限制，不等于 no effect（没有效应）。读的时候先把冒号两边分开，再回到 between A and B 的结构，就不会被 without 短语带偏。

sentenceNotes.sentence: Even where a policy changes behaviour in the way its supporters hoped, the outcomes that matter most may take years to show up in the data — and they may never show up in the measures a study happens to choose.
sentenceNotes.mainClause: 主句为 the outcomes may take years to show up in the data，主语 the outcomes，谓语 may take，宾语 years，to show up 作宾语补足成分；破折号后 and they may never show up... 是并列分句。
sentenceNotes.structure: Even where... 引导让步状语从句，where 相当于“在……的情况下”；in the way its supporters hoped 是方式状语，its supporters hoped 为省略关系词的定语从句；that matter most 是修饰 outcomes 的定语从句；the measures a study happens to choose 中 a study happens to choose 是省略关系词的定语从句，happen to do 表示“碰巧、恰好”。
sentenceNotes.translation: 即便一项政策如支持者所愿改变了行为，最重要的那些结果也可能要多年之后才在数据中显现——甚至可能永远不会出现在某项研究恰好选用的测量指标里。
sentenceNotes.tip: 本句为编辑自拟练习句，不是原刊引文。注意 Even where 不是“即使在哪里”，而是“即便在……的情况下”；破折号后的 they 指 the outcomes，不要把两个 show up 的对象混为一谈：前者是 data，后者是 measures。
